why.comeback: Last in the West 2020-22 with fans calling for new owners; Segal bought it 2021, Open Cup and West final 2023.
why.punch: 27th of 30 payroll (2025); 2023 Open Cup and West final, missed playoffs 2025.

why.comeback: Founded 2020; last in the East 2023 before Messi; no real adversity beyond 2021 rule-breach fines.
why.punch: Highest MLS payroll by far ($47m, 2025); 2024 Shield and 2025 MLS Cup bought with spending; cap fines 2021.

why.comeback: Fall from five-title club: wooden spoon 2017, sanctions and 'not a serious club' 2023; back to MLS Cup 2024, then 14th in the West 2025.
why.punch: 5th-highest payroll (2025); 2024 MLS Cup but 26th overall 2025 and misses 2017-21.

why.comeback: Founded 2018; only a missed-playoff 2021 before titles in 2022.
why.punch: Top-six payroll and big signings (Son, $26.5m 2025); Shields 2019/2022, MLS Cup 2022, Open Cup 2024, finals 2023: strong results for strong money.

why.comeback: Club had to find an owner by Oct 2012 to keep its NASL place; McGuire bought it, rose to MLS 2017.
why.punch: 26th of 30 payroll (2025) yet club-record 58 pts 2025 and playoffs in four of five seasons; no trophy.

why.comeback: Founded 2018 (MLS 2020); stadium lawsuit 2019 only.
why.punch: 8th-highest payroll (2025); 2025 Open Cup, Shield race 2026, but 2024 13th in the East and repeated first-round exits.

why.comeback: Five lost finals, worst season 2011 and owners called neglectful (2014); recoveries 2014 final and 2021 Shield; nothing defining.
why.punch: Mid payroll (16th, 2025); 2021 Shield but 11th in the East 2025.

why.comeback: No home of its own since 2015, matches spread across baseball and out-of-state grounds; MLS Cup 2021; own stadium due 2027 (owner-funded, not a fan fight).
why.punch: Low payroll (24th, 2025) yet MLS Cup 2021, conference finals 2022 and 2025; CFG backing and $20m+ transfer spend 2024 temper it.

why.comeback: USL club moved from Austin 2010; five years without MLS playoffs 2015-19; nothing defining.
why.punch: 19th payroll (2025); Open Cup 2022, club-best 2nd 2023, East final 2024; poor start 2026 and coach left.

why.comeback: Slow early years (two playoffs in seven seasons); no serious adversity; 2026 slump.
why.punch: 29th of 30 payroll (2025) yet Shields 2020 and 2025, MLS Cup final 2022; academy sold Aaronson, McKenzie; poor 2026 start.

why.comeback: Earlier Timbers folded 1990; 2021-22 abuse scandal, Timbers Army protests forced executive firings 2022; on-field decline since.
why.punch: 11th payroll (2025); MLS Cup final 2021, then missed or play-in exits 2022-25 and coach fired 2026.

why.comeback: Owner Hansen forced to sell 2020 after racist remarks; 2021 season with no owner, reached West final; new owners 2022, Miller family 2025.
why.punch: 28th of 30 payroll (2025), small market; West final 2021 and regular playoff berths since; no trophy.

why.comeback: MetroStars 'curse' and worst MLS record 1999, worst again 2009; 15 straight playoffs from 2010, missed 2025; distant lows.
why.punch: 9th payroll (2025); 15-year playoff streak and 2024 MLS Cup final with a set pressing model, but no MLS Cup and 10th in the East 2025.

why.comeback: Founded 2023, first season 2025: too new.
why.punch: 10th payroll (2025) yet 1st in the West with an expansion-record 63 pts and a West final; one full season only.

why.comeback: Team moved to Houston 2005, two-year hiatus, refounded 2008, own stadium 2015; last in MLS 2024, owner Fisher selling since 2025.
why.punch: 17th payroll (2025); last overall 2024, missed playoffs 2025; strong 2026 start after a Werner signing.

why.comeback: No serious adversity since joining MLS 2009; 2022 first playoff miss.
why.punch: 14th payroll (2025); CONCACAF Champions League 2022, Leagues Cup 2025, deep runs most years.

why.comeback: 2008-10 stadium plan scrapped, played in a baseball park; rebranded with own stadium 2011, MLS Cup 2013; slide to 15th in the West 2025.
why.punch: 15th payroll (2025) but 28 pts and 15th in the West 2025, long decline from 2013-17 peak.

why.comeback: First season 2023: too new.
why.punch: 13th payroll (2025); 1st in the West 2023, then 12th and 13th, 2026 Open Cup.

why.comeback: Eight years without playoffs 2007-14, treble 2017, then fall to bottom-five finishes 2021-25 with no recovery yet.
why.punch: 2nd-highest payroll (2025, $34m with Insigne, Bernardeschi) and 22nd-29th overall 2021-25.

why.comeback: Owners selling since Dec 2024, formal bid to move to Las Vegas 2026, BC Place lease ends May 2027; 'Save the Caps' protests; from last in the West 2019 to MLS Cup final 2025.
why.punch: 21st payroll (2025) yet 63 pts, MLS Cup final and Champions Cup final 2025, Canadian Championships 2022-25.

why.comeback: Founded 2020, first season 2022: too new.
why.punch: Richest NWSL club (revenue ~$31m 2023, $250m valuation) yet one playoff berth, 2024 salary-cap breach and points deduction, four coaches.

why.comeback: Founded 2023, first season 2024: too new.
why.punch: Record expansion fee and ~$125m planned investment, record transfer 2024; 7th 2024, 13th of 14 2025 (2026 unclear, estimate).

why.comeback: First season 2026: too new.
why.punch: Inaugural 2026, lost first five matches; too early to judge (estimate).

why.comeback: Left WPS for lack of funds 2010; Dames abuse scandal 2021, $1.5m fine and forced sale 2023, ground moves; recovery not yet (14th 2025).
why.punch: NWSL final 2021, then 12th 2023, 14th 2025 and five wins 2026 despite new owners' investment.
